source: Ed4 C.4.14, p.C-53; C.3, pp.C-7 to C-8; C.6, Table C-4 notes, p.C-67
description: Towards a peer recorded Ed3 the spare space of an ARQ transmission takes copies of the ED3-ACK-ONLY but no PADDING, and the only EOWs sent are ones defined for all editions.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. At 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with Ed4 clear, so it is recorded Ed3 (B-0228, B-0408); our accept, Ed4 clear, goes out at 52000 (25 bytes in one 35-byte block: the 10 spare bytes are zero filled, no PADDING towards an Ed3 peer, C-0367) and the link is made with the 8-bit family when it ends at 57550. At 61000 the peer's ED3-DATA-ONLY, TX FSN 0, 'ping' from SAP 5, carrying EOW 0xE00: type 14, RESERVED (Table C-4), which this node does not recognise. It is delivered (cas.first_data stops, S_UNIDATA_INDICATION) and owes an acknowledgement (C-0658, C-0730), and an UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR EOW naming type 14 is owed to the peer (C-0445, C-0447). At 83000 the ED3-ACK-ONLY (type 1: RX LWE 1, no SELECTIVE ACKS, 12 bytes, EOT 10) carries that EOW, 0x30E: UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR is an EOW for all editions, so it may go to an Ed3 peer (C-0401, C-0415), and it goes once (C-1079). Fill (C-0886, C-1154): 23 bytes of the block are spare. One copy of the ACK-ONLY goes (C-0369, C-0882), with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), not the Ed4 CAPABILITY EOW, since Ed4 EOWs are not sent to a peer known Ed3 (C-0044, C-0054, C-0419); a second copy (12 bytes) does not fit in the 11 left. Those 11 bytes would hold exactly one PADDING D_PDU, but PADDING goes only to Ed4 peers (C-0367, C-0055), so they are zero filled: the transmit output is the 24 bytes of the two ACK-ONLYs. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 35 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133): a type 1 is 12 bytes plus its SELECTIVE ACKS, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4: contention waits 45000, 12000 ms (K-0080).
